_comment: One fully worked planner beat. scripts/gemini-visual-plan.js embeds this file in the planner prompt (the model cannot open files). The planner describes the scene AND names the beat's type, composition, ground and layout (visual_type, canvas_composition, ground, layout); scripts/scene-translate.js builds the candidates for what it named and the grounding gate checks them against the sentence. A field left out falls back: no visual_type -> the description decides; no ground -> the house white; no layout -> the composition's default arrangement. The layout here is THIS beat's own; each beat's comes from its own content.
sentence: Jerome Powell said rates will stay high.

beat.headline: Rates stay high
beat.scene_description: A portrait of Jerome Powell, the Federal Reserve chairman, standing in the lower half of the frame; a slow push in across the beat. Above him, small caps: RATES WILL. The headline pops in word by word.
